Fixtures of public/science/imaging/decode/tiff (ADR-0398 §SD6, Verification
plan). Every file here is synthetic: its samples are arithmetic on the pixel
coordinates, written on 2026-11-21 by gen_fixtures.py.txt with tifffile
2026.11.16 (numpy 2.5.5, imagecodecs 2026.11.11 for the codecs). No file is
cut from a real image, so none carries a licence of its own.

expect.tsv holds, per file, what the reader must return: size, sample kind,
pages and bands, the colour model, and the SHA-256 of the samples — every
page, then every band, each plane row-major with its samples little-endian —
computed from the arrays the files were written from. The affine, the EPSG
code, the nodata value, the band descriptions, scales and offsets were read
back by GDAL 3.12.2 through rasterio 1.5.2, a second implementation, which
places a PixelIsPoint raster as this reader does.

The generator is not run by any lane; tests read only the committed files and
expect.tsv. refused_jpeg.tif and refused_zstd.tif have no row: the reader
refuses them by name.
